title: E2MoCase: A Dataset for Emotional, Event and Moral Observations in News Articles on High-impact Legal Cases
findings: Religious bias was identified as one of five categories of cultural bias in media coverage of high-impact legal cases. This bias category accounts for 2.4% of the paragraphs in the created E2MoCase dataset. The paper did not provide further analysis specific to the religious bias category.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures cultural biases in news reporting on legal cases. One of the specific biases measured is 'religious bias', defined as unfair treatment or attitudes towards individuals or groups based on their religious beliefs.
